options.description: Ordered categorical options available to the scorer.

selection_mode.description:
Whether reviewers can select one option or multiple options. Defaults to `single`.

* `single` - single
* `multiple` - multiple

min_selections.description: Optional minimum number of options that can be selected when `selection_mode` is `multiple`.

max_selections.description: Optional maximum number of options that can be selected when `selection_mode` is `multiple`.
